title: 2 Samuel 1–8 source-map current-SHA independent reclosure
reviewType: Independent semantic reclosure after author repairs; no profile-quality approval.

closedFindings.evidence: 1:18 parenthesized “he commanded them” follows David’s lament; current map adds David context.

3:3 has one Carmel link; person:daniel_939 is justified by the related Chileab article, which identifies Chileab as also known as Daniel (article opening, lines 113–115) and cites 1 Chronicles 3:1 plus 2 Samuel 3:3.
3:7 explicitly says Ishbosheth said to Abner; link is direct.
7:11 explicitly names the LORD twice; God is direct.
7:15 continues divine first-person speech but does not name LORD/God; God is context and Saul direct.
8:5 says “Syrians of Damascus”; Aram is excluded as an unspoken region, Syrians remain an unresolved collective. 8:6 explicitly says “Syria of Damascus”, so Aram remains direct there.
The candidate alternatives now have verse-specific excludedCandidates at 2:9, 5:3, 6:2, 8:2, and 8:12.
8:12 contrasts the collective Amalek person ID with the separate region candidate, and explains the local population/war-spoils use.
Removed false Amorite and Philistine unresolved references (the remaining Philistine/Aram/Ammon/Edom collective references match fixed text).
Unresolved collective candidates include Syrians 8:5/6/13, Ammonites 8:12, Philistines 8:12, and Edomites 8:14; no geography ID is substituted for the missing group IDs.
